text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having received messages of support from 
the folks in the shopping district, Nice 
Nature aims for victory to live up to 
their encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Arima Kinen was where 
champions across generations gathered, 
including the likes of Mejiro McQueen and 
Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This race wouldn't be a walk in the park. 
To overcome them and become the 
"protagonist," Nice Nature headed out to 
the track.
